Free Space Wiper fills all free space of an Android storage with random data, makes sure it reaches the flash, and deletes it again, so that deleted files cannot be recovered. How it works and how it was tested: [README]({{URL}}/blob/{{TAG}}/README.md).

**Install:** download `FreeSpaceWiper-{{VERSION}}.apk` below. Needs Android 6.0 or later. If another build of the app is installed, uninstall it first: every build is signed with its own key.

**SHA-256:** `{{SHA256}}`

---

空间覆写：把可用空间全部写满随机数据，确认落到闪存上再删除，让已删除的文件无法恢复。原理和测试结果见[中文说明]({{URL}}/blob/{{TAG}}/README.zh-CN.md)。

**安装：**下载下方的 `FreeSpaceWiper-{{VERSION}}.apk`，需要 Android 6.0 或更高版本。手机上装过其他构建的话请先卸载：每次构建的签名密钥都不同。
